correctness.rationale: The Fefferman density and monomial norm agree with the full originating paper and are reconstructed from coarea. Every auxiliary U in the disk is realizable and all kernel factors away from P_n are nonzero. Finite differences yield exact rational P_n for all ten n=2..11. For each Q_n, the embedded checker computes principal Hurwitz minors with exact fraction-free integers and Routh pivot signs independently using exact fractions; n<=10 have no right-half-plane roots and n=11 has exactly 2. No zero pivots/imaginary-axis degeneracy arises. Positive power series on (0,1) and exact alternating P coefficients on (-1,0) exclude real disk zeros at n11; conjugacy proves two simple roots. Numeric root values are illustrations only.

value.rationale: Kernel zero-freeness is a natural global off-diagonal geometric property, distinct from the origin paper’s positive diagonal and curvature rigidity. The result identifies the exact first failure in complex dimension 11 for the canonical simplest nonspherical finite-type egg (m=2), and a complex-conjugate pair of zero fibers. This is a meaningful complete finite cutoff rather than an arbitrary numerical slice. It does not claim unknown higher dimensions.
